Unregister a condathis backend

Source: R/backend.R
unregister_backend.Rd

Removes a backend added with register_backend(): the registry entry and the S3 methods registered for its class. Call it from the .onUnload() of a backend package (see Registering from a backend package in register_backend()). Then an unloaded package leaves no registered backend whose functions belong to a missing namespace.

Usage

unregister_backend(name, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

name

Character string with the backend name to unregister.

call

The environment reported as the caller in errors, for calls from another package's .onUnload(), as in rlang.

Value

Logical, invisibly: TRUE if a backend was unregistered, FALSE if no backend by that name was registered. A malformed name aborts with class condathis_backend_invalid_name, and a reserved one with condathis_backend_reserved_name (also condathis_backend_invalid_name).

Details

Unregistering a name that is not registered does nothing and returns FALSE, so an unload hook never fails on cleanup that has nothing left to clean. unregister_backend() refuses the reserved names of register_backend(), because the built-in "micromamba" backend is always registered.

Part of the experimental backend extension API. See the Lifecycle section of register_backend().

See also

Other backends: backend_root_dir(), list_registered_backend_names(), register_backend()

Examples

# A minimal backend: the three required functions, which this example
# does not implement. It reports that it is unavailable, so
# `method = "auto"` never selects it. condathis supplies the other
# functions: they look for environments in
# `backend_root_dir("mybackend")/envs`. A backend package builds this
# object in its own constructor, for example `new_backend_mybackend()` in
# *Registering from a backend package* of `?register_backend`.
not_implemented <- function(...) {
  stop("Not implemented by this example backend.")
}
mybackend <- structure(
  list(
    backend_create_env = not_implemented,
    backend_install = not_implemented,
    backend_resolve_run = not_implemented,
    backend_available = function(backend) FALSE
  ),
  class = c("condathis_backend_mybackend", "condathis_backend")
)

condathis::register_backend("mybackend", mybackend)
condathis::list_registered_backend_names()
#> [1] "micromamba" "mybackend" 

condathis::unregister_backend("mybackend")
condathis::list_registered_backend_names()
#> [1] "micromamba"
